info.title: agentsd: sessions
info.description: The host methods of the sessions group; see daemon.openrpc.json for the rest of the document.

methods.name: agents/cancelContinue
methods.description: The chat no longer carries on by itself (#1859). Nothing happens when it was not waiting to.

methods.name: agents/continueInNew
methods.description: Continue in New (#999): start a session in the same folder that reads this one and carries on, with its runtime, choices and the person's labels, on another account: the one given, else the runtime's account for new sessions. For a session whose account the organisation removed or no longer allows. Refused with policyRefused when the policy refuses that account.

methods.name: agents/continueWhenBack
methods.description: A chat paused by a spent allowance carries on when the allowance is back (#1859): at the provider's reset time, or the app's next check, or as soon as a turn on that runtime works or the person marks it available. Refused for a chat that is not paused by a spent allowance.

methods.name: agents/endedElsewhere
methods.description: From the control plane only (#2927): a session an agent here started on another machine has ended, so the waits on it close. Refused unless that agent started a session of that id on that machine.

methods.name: agents/fromStarter
methods.description: From the control plane only (#2927): the agent on another machine that started a session here reads, messages, stops or archives it, or asks how it stands. Refused unless it started it.

methods.name: agents/move
methods.description: The person moving an agent, or taking back the move that is waiting (053).

methods.name: agents/moveIn
methods.description: A session moving here from another of the person's machines with move_session (#3717), through the control plane: its export, uploaded with folders/receiveUpload, goes on here with its id, in the folder its branch was sent to.

methods.name: agents/moveToMachine
methods.description: Move to Machine… (#3790): the person moves a session to another of their machines, as move_session does (#3717). Its turn stops if one runs, its branch goes there with its uncommitted changes, and it goes on there with the same id; this machine lets it go. It checks the move and answers at once (#4641): move/changed says how it goes, and the session stays here until that machine has it.

methods.name: agents/moves
methods.description: The moves to another machine this host is making (#4641), the oldest first, for a client that connects mid-move.

methods.name: agents/setClientPermission
methods.description: An agent's own answer to permission requests on Cursor, Grok and OpenCode (#2658, FR-019); no mode follows Settings. Applied from its next request.

methods.name: agents/setLevels
methods.description: Change a running agent's model level or permission mode (#2658, Story 2): mapped on its own runtime, applied from its next step.

methods.name: agents/startNow
methods.description: A person starts a queued session at once (#5156): past the folder's running limit, never past its total. Not an agent's: the agent role cannot call it, and no app tool does.

methods.name: agents/summaryFacts
methods.description: From the control plane only (#3354): this machine's facts for the daily summary that another of the person's machines writes: sessions done and stopped, what waits on the person, suggestions not taken, and what the checks found here.

methods.name: auto/changed
methods.description: The saved Auto settings (#2658).

methods.name: auto/mappings
methods.description: Every cell of the Auto mappings, marked, with each runtime's own choices (#2658).

methods.name: auto/preview
methods.description: The runtime Auto would pick now for these levels and folder, or why none can (#2658).

methods.name: auto/set
methods.description: Save the Auto order, the runtimes left out and the person's own cells (#2658, FR-017).

methods.name: capacity/changed
methods.description: The machine's capacity level moved (#4748): its rows say Near capacity or At capacity, as a low disk.

methods.name: capacity/state
methods.description: The machine's capacity level now (#4748), asked on connect; capacity/changed says each move after.

methods.name: clientPermissions/changed
methods.description: The saved permission modes (061).

methods.name: clientPermissions/set
methods.description: Save the permission modes and return what was saved (061).

methods.name: dailySummary/changed
methods.description: The daily summary's control changed (#3351): by dailySummary/setSettings, or by a change to the home folder's Daily summary workflow. Sent with every workflow change.

methods.name: dailySummary/setSettings
methods.description: Sets the daily summary's control (#3351): turns the home folder's Daily summary workflow on or off and sets its time. It answers the settings as they now are.

methods.name: dailySummary/settings
methods.description: The daily summary's control (#3351), read from the home folder's Daily summary workflow. dailySummary/changed says when it changes.

methods.name: live/frame
methods.description: A live tile's frame (#4139): what an agent drives (source screen, browser or simulator), sent only within 10 seconds of the agent's last call on it, and only to the connections whose presence/report is active and shows that agent. Never recorded. desktopControl/liveFrame goes on beside it until every client reads this one.

methods.name: multiplier/changed
methods.description: The Multiplier changed (#3903): a PR of the person's agents merged or a revert merged, with the PR in changedBy, or the person changed their baseline (#3991), with no changedBy. The Mac window follows it; it does not poll.

methods.name: multiplier/state
methods.description: The Multiplier now (#3903): from the control plane's count of the person's machines when this machine has one, else from this machine's lineage. Cheap: the Mac window asks on each open.

methods.name: reviews/dismiss
methods.description: Take a pull request out of the sidebar's For Review (#3330) for good: the host keeps the dismissal.

methods.name: reviews/open
methods.description: Say that the person opened a pull request in the sidebar's For Review (#3464): the host keeps it, and its row is drawn read.

methods.name: suggestions/dismiss
methods.description: Take a suggestion of the daily checks out of the sidebar's For Review (#3331) for good: the host keeps the dismissal, so neither For Review nor the next daily summary lists it, and the checks do not keep it again.

methods.name: suggestions/start
methods.description: Start on a suggestion of the daily checks in For Review (#3331): the host starts a session in its folder with its prompt, on the Auto runtime, and takes the suggestion out. The result is the new session's id.

methods.name: summaries/changed
methods.description: The daily summary's saved pages changed (#3721): a page was saved, or read with summaries/read. The pages, newest first, as summaries/list answers.

methods.name: summaries/list
methods.description: The daily summary's saved pages on this machine (#3721), newest first: at most the last three. summaries/changed says when they change.

methods.name: summaries/read
methods.description: A saved page of the daily summary and its Markdown (#3721). Reading the newest page marks it read, and the session that wrote it too.

methods.name: velocity/history
methods.description: The PRs the agents worked on that landed, by the hour and the day and by repository (#4596), counted from this machine's lineage store on each ask: the same PRs the Multiplier counts.
